title: command block plus
body:
Have you ever accidentally broke your important command block without saving the command somewhere?

Did you ever accidentally open the command block trying to click the button and then modified command randomly?

Are you annoyed by the fact that when you take the command block from the operator tab you need to go to the redstone tab to find something to activate it?

Well... if you are looking for solution to all this problems, you dont have to look any further, this pack have solution to all of them with just one tool
